title: Sturdy “Y” Peeler; Blade Not Particularly Sharp
text:
Sturdy “Y” Peeler; Blade Not Particularly Sharp. This FARBERWARE PROFESSIONAL VEGETABLE PEELER (“Y” Peeler, Black) works just like any other “Y” vegetable peeler. Because it is advertised as a “professional” kitchen tool, I expected the blade to be very sharp. However, the blade isn’t any sharper than the blade on my other less fancy “Y” peelers.

The peeler handle is big and heavy. No doubt the peeler is extra sturdy, but I don’t like the way that it feels in my hand. This was a big disappointment, because I’m generally a huge fan of Farberware products.
